subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - next steps
message_1_subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - next steps
message_1_body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — really appreciate the deep dive on your realtime recommendations use case. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

- Summary: FintechCo is evaluating a dedicated inference pool to meet predictable throughput for recommendation scoring and chat assistants. You mentioned peak bursts around business hours and a strict 95th-percentile latency SLO for generation endpoints.
- Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing & technical deep dive (Marissa/Platform eng + your infra lead) to align on throughput, latency targets, and integration constraints.

Can you confirm who on your side should attend (we have you and Jordan looped) and share a couple 60-90 minute windows that work next week? If helpful, we can propose Wed/Thu mornings PT.

I've attached a short mutual action plan and a sizing template we typically fill out before the call — if you can drop the high-level QPS and average payload sizes there it will speed things up.

Thanks,
David

--
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
message_2_subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call - next steps
message_2_body:
Hi David — thanks for the recap. Jordan (SRE) and I should be on the call. A few quick answers for the template before the meeting:

- Expected peak TPS: ~150 requests/sec (short bursts up to 220 rps for 60-90s)
- Sustained average: ~40 rps
- Typical payload: 1-2 KB per request for generation; embeddings ~300-400 bytes
- Latency SLO: generation endpoints 95th < 200ms; embeddings 95th < 80ms
- Model footprint: planning to run an LLM ~13B with quantized weights (we can share the exact model after NDA)

We're available Wed 2027-06-09 10:00-11:30 PT or Thu 2027-06-10 09:00-10:30 PT. Either works for us — let me know what you prefer and we can confirm a calendar invite.

—Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Platform, FintechCo
alex.turner@fintechco.com
